---
title: Mitten pattern template
description: Reusable Markdown template for writing and sharing knit or crochet mitten patterns with sections for sizing, gauge, materials, and step-by-step directions for cuff, hand, thumb gusset, and thumb
---

Use this reusable template to write and share your knit or crochet mitten patterns in Markdown. Fill in the bracketed sections with your pattern details. This template works for fingerless mitts, full mittens, convertible mittens, and thumb gusset or afterthought thumb constructions.

---

### Gauge

[e.g., 24 sts x 32 rounds / 4 in / 10 cm in stockinette or main stitch pattern on larger needles]

If using stranded colorwork, swatch in the stranded pattern — colorwork gauge is often tighter than stockinette. Swatch in the round if the mitten is worked in the round. Wash and block your swatch before measuring.

### Charts

**Chart Key**

| Symbol | Stitch |
|---|---|
| [ ] | Knit in MC |
| [ ] | Knit in CC |
| [ ] | M1 in MC |
| [ ] | Embroider in CC after knitting (knit st in MC, embroider over it) |

If using embroidered details, work stitches indicated in the chart in MC. After finishing, embroider over them with CC using a duplicate stitch or backstitch.

## Pattern Instructions

### Cuff

Using smaller needles and MC, CO [N] sts. Place marker and join for working in the round.

```plaintext
[Instructions for cuff: ribbing, decorative braid, folded hem, etc.]
```

**Colorwork cuff (optional):** For a patterned cuff, work from a cuff chart on smaller needles before transitioning to the hand.

### Left Mitten Hand

Change to larger needles.

**Work from chart:** Work Rounds 1-[N] of Hand Chart. Hand chart is worked [N] times around.

**Worked even (no chart):**

```plaintext
[Work in main stitch pattern for N rounds]
```

**Thumb gusset (if applicable):**

```plaintext
[Increase round: M1, work to marker, M1 — worked every N rounds N times]
[Place gusset sts on waste yarn when complete]
```

### Right Mitten Hand

Work as for left mitten, reversing thumb gusset placement (work increases at the opposite side of the marker). If left and right mittens use different chart sections, follow the chart for the right mitten here.

### Afterthought Thumb (alternative)

Knit hand to desired length without gusset. At thumb placement point, knit across [N] sts with waste yarn, then slip those sts back to the left needle and knit them again with main yarn. Continue hand to top.

### Thumb

**For gusset thumb:** Place held gusset sts on larger needles. Pick up and knit [N] sts from the gap, then pick up [N] additional sts on each side of the gap for a smooth transition.

```plaintext
[Work thumb even until N in / cm from pick-up]
[Decrease to close if needed]
```

**For afterthought thumb:** Remove waste yarn and place live sts on larger needles. Pick up additional sts at edges.

```plaintext
[Work thumb even, decrease to close]
```
